visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with a full, rounded face and short brown hair is seen in a medium close-up, wearing a black tank top and holding a thumbs-up gesture. He is in a brightly lit indoor hallway with white walls and a ceiling vent. (2) The scene jump-cuts through various gym environments; the man maintains his thumbs-up pose while his face gradually becomes thinner and more defined. Lighting shifts between warm indoor tones and bright studio-style lighting as he stands in front of exercise equipment. (3) The character appears in a locker room setting with blue lighting in the background, still holding the same pose with a steady gaze. (4) The final sequence shows the man with a significantly sharper jawline and leaner facial structure, standing in a gym with a brick wall and industrial lighting, concluding the transformation journey.
